name: Bone Dry Solar
old_description: Bone Dry Solar helps homeowners harness the power of the sun to generate clean, renewable energy and reduce their reliance on traditional fossil fuels. Our team of experts specializes in designing and installing customized solar energy systems that meet the unique needs and preferences of each homeowner. Get in contact with our team today to schedule an appointment for solar services.
about:
Bone Dry Solar, based in Indianapolis, Indiana, was founded in 1989 as a family-owned roofing and solar installation business. The company began as Bone Dry Roofing and expanded into solar services, operating across nine states with a workforce of approximately 500 employees.

The firm designs and installs roof-mounted, ground-mounted, and off-grid solar arrays for residential and commercial customers, and provides solar repair and maintenance programs that include monthly monitoring and an annual 10-point inspection. In addition to solar, the company offers a full range of roofing services—replacement, installation, repair, maintenance, and inspection—as well as gutters, masonry, insulation, siding, painting, commercial roofing, and drywall work.

Bone Dry Solar serves homeowners seeking to reduce electricity costs and carbon emissions, along with commercial property owners requiring roofing and solar solutions. The company holds preferred-contractor certifications from Owens Corning (Platinum Preferred) and CertainTeed (ShingleMaster Select), and backs its workmanship with a limited lifetime warranty.

The company emphasizes its longevity—over three decades in business—and a service model that includes free estimates, a dedicated maintenance plan, and a commitment to revisit installations after five years for inspection at no cost.
